description: This file defines the code-behind class for the TakenCourses page in an online examination system. It handles page load and button click events for navigation between different pages such as Dashboard, UserProfile, Leaderboard, and Login.

classes.name: TakenCourses
classes.description: Code-behind class for the TakenCourses ASP.NET Web Forms page, managing navigation button click events.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, currently with no specific logic.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the Home button, transfers user to the Dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the Profile button, transfers user to the UserProfile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the Leaderboard button, transfers user to the Leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the Logout button, transfers user to the LoginPage.
